name: Death by Mixer
source:
Going to your favourite bar, with your long-time friend and a few [s]definitely not unstable[/s] young and [s]not so young[/s] men. What a great evening, nothing can ruin this for you... right...? RIGHT?
In this thrilling [s]kidnapping[/s] dating simulator you get to romance a [s]psycho[/s] charming youth of your choice, getting to know them better after they fall for you hard enough to [s]commit a class A felony punishable by a minimum of 15 to 25 years in prison[/s] do whatever it takes to get with you!

[From [url=https://t0talbra1nd3ath.itch.io/death-by-mixer-demo1]Itch.io[/url]]
